key.name: enabled
key.description: Whether RaySlash responds to desktop drags.

key.name: color-mode
key.description: The system accent color, a preset color, or a custom color.

key.name: custom-color
key.description: The custom RGB color used when color-mode is custom.

key.name: size-preset
key.description: The base and maximum width of the ribbon.

key.name: style
key.description: The layered rendering style used for the ribbon.

key.name: timing-preset
key.description: How quickly the completed ribbon fades away after release.

key.name: trail-preset
key.description: How much recent path remains visible while the button is held.

key.name: speed-response
key.description: How strongly pointer speed changes ribbon width.
